name: Doctor of Philosophy
previous: The Doctor of Philosophy at UTS is a rigorous research degree that demands a significant period of supervised study culminating in a substantial and original contribution to knowledge. It is a pathway for those aiming for leadership roles in sectors that rely on research to address real-world challenges, including academia, business, government, and cultural or community organisations. Candidates develop analytical, problem-solving, communication and project management skills that are highly valued for academic careers and for careers in industry, research, government and non-government organisations.
description:

Candidates develop analytical, problem-solving, communication and project management skills that are highly valued for academic careers and for careers in industry, research, government and non-government organisations.
The UTS course code is C02092 (CRICOS 008663G). The standard length is 4 years full-time or 8 years part-time.

name: Master of Transdisciplinary Innovation (Research)
previous:
The Master of Transdisciplinary Innovation (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree based in the UTS TD School. Students design their program with a supervisor, investigate a real-world challenge across disciplines over about two years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a portfolio or creative artefact.
The degree develops research, systems thinking and collaboration skills for innovation roles across industry, government and non-profits, or a pathway to a PhD.

name: Master of Sustainable Futures (Research)
previous:
The Master of Sustainable Futures (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time, based in the UTS Institute for Sustainable Futures. Students design their program with a supervisor, investigate a chosen sustainability topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a policy proposal or portfolio.
The degree develops research and analysis skills for careers in sustainability policy, consulting, government and further doctoral study.

name: Master of Design (Research)
previous:

name: Master of Learning Analytics (Research)

name: Master of Science (Research)
previous:
The Master of Science (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Science, work on a chosen science topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as an algorithm or venture.
The degree develops research and problem-solving skills for industry research and development, or as a pathway to a PhD.
